mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.7% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.7.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS indicate aggressive monetary tightening that raises real interest rates and equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising CPIAUCSL and rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 200) trigger aggressive Fed policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 200.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 1200) indicates robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days without conditional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 200 thousand (PAYEMS > 200) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 200.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based consumer demand expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and rising RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110) signals economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days in manufacturing downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.
